Existing same-payload records that are already beyond PREPARED may still be returned idempotently without transport. This rule does not turn an in-memory _save_state no-op into proof of durability.

If adapter.submit_order raises after durable SUBMIT_ATTEMPTED or the outcome is otherwise unknown, never convert it to REJECTED/unsent. Persist status nonterminal PENDING plus execution_lifecycle_state=RECONCILE_PENDING and broker_observation_state=RECONCILE_PENDING while preserving broker_order_id/payload/hash, then return the current OrderResult. If that persistence fails, propagate; the already durable SUBMIT_ATTEMPTED disk state remains the restart authority. An acknowledgement-persistence failure similarly leaves SUBMIT_ATTEMPTED as disk authority and must never authorize a resend.

Map authoritative acknowledgements/updates on the same record into lifecycle PENDING, ACCEPTED, PARTIALLY_FILLED, FILLED, CANCELED, REJECTED, or RECONCILE_PENDING as appropriate; TIMED_OUT/unknown observation is RECONCILE_PENDING, not proof of unsent. RakutenRssOrderUpdate gains one appended backward-compatible field fill_event_id:str="". Zero-fill/status-only updates may leave it empty. Every positive incremental fill_quantity delivered to broker accounting requires a non-empty stable source fill_event_id before economic mutation. _apply_fill rejects non-integer/non-positive fill quantity, non-finite/non-positive fill price, missing/unproven fill_event_id, and remaining-quantity overflow before broker/account mutation. Never synthesize a production fill_event_id from quantity/price/time/poll order/rss_order_id or a fingerprint that is not an authoritative unique execution identity.

Broker fill replay authority is persistent and order-scoped. For each order, persist an applied_fill_events ledger keyed by non-empty fill_event_id with the exact incremental fill quantity and price that were economically applied. For an unseen fill_event_id, validate identity/economics and apply that incremental fill exactly once, then persist the event ledger with the resulting cumulative order/account state. For a previously applied fill_event_id with identical incremental quantity/price on the same persisted order, suppress the economic _apply_fill mutation as an idempotent replay while still allowing valid non-economic status/RSS-identity/lifecycle observation updates. The same fill_event_id with conflicting quantity/price is a hard FILL_EVENT_ID_CONFLICT before economic mutation. A positive fill with empty fill_event_id is FILL_EVENT_ID_NOT_PROVEN before economic mutation. On load, if applied_fill_events is present, validate non-empty unique IDs, positive finite economics, total quantity <= requested quantity, total event quantity equals persisted filled_quantity, and weighted event economics agree with the persisted cumulative filled price at existing broker precision; malformed/corrupt replay state fails closed. Legacy STATE_VERSION=1 records without applied_fill_events remain loadable. If such a legacy record has zero filled quantity it may initialize a proven-empty event ledger; if it already has positive filled quantity, any later positive incremental fill is NOT_PROVEN and must not be economically applied because prior event identity history is unavailable.

Add RakutenRssBroker.reconcile_order(client_order_id, *, now=None) as the only new Phase-5 single-order poll/reconcile method. It requires an existing record. PREPARED is proven-unsent and is not polled. Terminal FILLED/CANCELED/REJECTED records are not polled and may return only their persisted cumulative observation if filled_quantity>0. For SUBMIT_ATTEMPTED, transition and persist RECONCILE_PENDING before polling. Never call adapter.submit_order, adapter.cancel_order, cancel_order, engage_kill_switch, or refresh_pending_orders; nonterminal observation uses only adapter.poll_order. Poll exceptions preserve/persist RECONCILE_PENDING. Every positive incremental update returned by poll_order must pass the fill_event_id exactly-once gate before _apply_fill.

reconcile_order must expose persisted broker-authoritative cumulative fill for strategy/protection restart catch-up: if the existing record already has filled_quantity>0, include self._result_from_record(record) as the first cumulative observation even when poll returns no new update or the order is terminal. This persisted cumulative observation is a read of already-applied broker economics and is not re-entered into incremental _apply_fill. Then process each newly polled update in order. For positive incremental fills, apply the fill_event_id dedupe/conflict gate first; an identical replay event produces no second economic quantity/cash/average-price mutation. After each valid update/status application, run existing SELL-protection observation sync where applicable and _save_state before the next update. Return cumulative OrderResult observations in order.
